en: Black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a long sandy beach crowded with bathers, a seaside promenade and rows of modernist resort hotels/apartment blocks along the Black Sea coast. The reverse reads 'CARTE POSTALĂ', has a blue Romanian stamp 'POSTA ROMANA 40 BANI' with postal cancellations, the publisher 'Editura Meridiane', the printed location 'MAMAIA', and a handwritten message and address in blue ink to Brăila.
